item.title: Digimon Story: Time Stranger Is Getting A Major Expansion In 2027
item.description:
With another 50+ Digimon to collect
Digimon Story: Time Stranger is getting a major DLC expansion in 2027 titled A Hero's Eternal Legacy, Bandai Namco has announced.
The new trailer showcases some gorgeous gameplay set in a wide open space with lots of Digimon to take on. In fact, there are over 50 new Digimon to collect in what is being described as "an all-new adventure".
There's no firm release date for this one yet, but it looks good. We'll be keeping a close eye on it.
"In Digimon Story Time Stranger: A Hero’s Eternal Legacy, a new hero emerges as players embark on a journey of courage and friendship through the unexplored lands of Iliad. Along the way, they will encounter more than 50 new Digimon in this all-new adventure."
Subscribe to Nintendo Life on YouTube851k
In our review for Time Stranger, we said that its "monster-battling is as fun as ever, and the time-hopping, dimension-crossing story is a blast from start to finish", awarding it a score of 9/10.
Will you be checking out the upcoming Digimon Story: Time Stranger expansion? Let us know with a comment.

item.title: Japanese Charts: Elden Ring Puts Up A Good Fight, But It's Felled By The Reigning Champ
item.description:
Frisbee Dog, The Fell Omen
We have another look at the latest numbers for physical game sales in Japan, courtesy of Famitsu, and Elden Ring: Tarnished Edition has put up a pretty good fight in its debut week.
The Switch 2 release dodge rolled onto the podium right from the jump, shifting 27,604 copies. It wasn't quite enough to get that 'Great Enemy Felled' message, though, as the reigning champ, Rhythm Heaven Groove, snatched up another victory.
The chart is awash with new releases this week, with Metal Gear Solid: Master Collection Vol. 2 on PS5, Switch 2 and Switch 1 landing in third, sixth and eighth respectively, and Final Fantasy X | X-2 HD Remaster making its Switch 2 debut in seventh.
Subscribe to Nintendo Life on YouTube851k
Here's a look at the top ten in full:
Elden Ring: Tarnished Edition
Metal Gear Solid: Master Collection Vol. 2
Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream
Metal Gear Solid: Master Collection Vol. 2
Final Fantasy X | X-2 HD Remaster
Metal Gear Solid: Master Collection Vol. 2
Captain Tsubasa II: World Fighters
The hardware standing is in much the same state that we find it every week at the moment. Switch 2 is still in a commanding lead with an additional ~22,000 units to its name, with the PS5 Digital Edition holding onto the silver with 5,866.
Combining the Switch and PS5's respective SKU sales this week actually puts Nintendo in front, with the previous-gen ha rdware combining for 8,847, while Sony's latest pulls in 7,351.

item.title: Final Fantasy Resonance Demo Arrives On Switch 1 & 2 Today
item.description:
It may have been revealed during Sony's State of Play showcase, but we Nintendo fans can get involved, too — Final Fantasy Resonance is getting a free demo on Switch 1 & 2 today!
The demo encompasses the game's entire first chapter, and you'll be able to carry all of your save data over to the full release if you like what you see.
For those who have missed this one so far, Resonance is Final Fantasy's first foray into the wonderful world of HD-2D, adapting part of the Brave Exvius storyline from the 2015 mobile game. It features returning characters from the series as powerful 'Visions' and marks a long-awaited return to some classic turn-based battles.
Subscribe to Nintendo Life on YouTube851k
The demo will be coming our way later on today before the full game launches on 22nd October.
Will you be checking out the free Resonance demo on Switch? Let us know in the comments.

item.title: Final Fantasy VII Revelation Is A Game-Key Card On Switch 2, And It's No Wonder With That File Size
item.description:
Square Enix popped up at the end of Sony's State of Play showcase to reveal Final Fantasy VII Revelation's April 2027 release date, and we've now got some more info on the Switch 2 physical release.
As shown on the Square Enix website, Revelation will be a Game-Key Card release on Switch 2, with pre-orders now available for £69.99 / $69.99 / €79.99. Considering that the first two entries in the Remake trilogy received a similar GKC release, this is hardly surprising, but it's even less so for this third entry, as it has a whopping file size.
According to the site listing, the Revelation card will require a whopping 130GB full game download on launch, which puts the low-90GBs of its predecessors to shame.
Looking at today's new footage, it certainly seems like there's a lot of game included in that file. Revelation features a huge-looking open world, complete with side quests galore, and a flyable airship just a button press away.
Still, 130GB! That sure is something. Better pick up one of those Micro SD Express cards at some point, eh?
While we're on expensive purchases, Square Enix has also revealed the Revelation Collector's Edition. Alongside a copy of the game, this one also bundles in an artbook, soundtrack, exclusive steelbook case and a Cloud, Zack and Sephiroth statue for... wait for it... £349.99 / $349.99 / €389.99.
We love a statue as much as the next man, but that price? Ouch.
Will you be picking up FFVII Revelation on Switch 2? Let us know in the comments.

item.title: Final Fantasy VII Revelation To Offer Story Expansion Pass With Sephiroth, Turks DLC
item.description:
The two additions arrive between "Winter 2027 and Spring 2028"
Final Fantasy VII Revelation is to receive multiple post-release story expansions, according to a Steam listing that's gone live after today's release date reveal.
Available both individually or as part of a Story Expansion Pass, the two story DLC packs will first focus on Sephiroth then Vincent and the Turks, and will release sometime between "Winter 2027 and Spring 2028".
Specifics beyond that - such as when in the story they will be set, and whether Sephiroth and the Turks themselves will be playable - have yet to be detailed.
The Final Fantasy VII Revelation Story Expansion Pass also features a 'Accessory: Reclaimant Choker & Survival Set', which can be downloaded as soon as the game is available in April 2027.
The listing for the 'Story Expansion Pass' is as follows:
FINAL FANTASY VII REVELATION's Story Expansion Pass. This product includes Accessory: Reclaimant Choker & Survival Set, Story DLC 1: Sephiroth, and Story DLC 2: Vincent & the Turks.
■Story Expansion Pass Content:
- Accessory: Reclaimant Choker & Survival Set (An accessory that slightly restores HP when enemies are defeated and a set of items that will aid you during the early stages of your journey.)
- Story DLC 1: Sephiroth - Story DLC 2: Vincent & the Turks
* The Story Expansion Pass will also be available for individual purchase after the release of FINAL FANTASY VII REVELAT ION.
* Story DLC 1 and Story DLC 2 are planned to be released between Winter 2027 and Spring 2028. * Story DLC 1 and Story DLC 2 will also be available for individual purchase after their respective releases. * Please note that the content of each, their planned release date, etc. are subject to change without prior notice.
Any longtime Final Fantasy 7 fans have any thoughts on what the Sephiroth and Turks DLC could focus on? Let us know in the comments.
[source store.steampowered.com]
